Condition classes of condathis

Source: R/condathis-conditions.R
condathis-conditions.Rd

Every error that condathis raises has the class condathis_error, and every warning has the class condathis_warning. Each condition also has more specific classes. Use them to handle one kind of problem with base::tryCatch(), base::withCallingHandlers() or rlang::try_fetch(), and to test for it with testthat::expect_error(class = ). Do not match the text of a message: it can change in any release.

The class scheme

The classes of a condition go from the most specific to the most general:

  1. The class of the function and the problem, condathis_<function>_<problem>, with the full name of the exported function. For example:

    • condathis_create_env_exists

    • condathis_run_bin_env_not_found

  2. Older names of that class, kept so that existing handlers still work (see Renamed classes). Some classes carry further names that this page does not list: do not rely on them.

  3. Shared classes for the kind of problem. For example:

    • condathis_invalid_overwrite and condathis_invalid_arg

    • condathis_env_not_found

  4. The root class, condathis_error or condathis_warning.

The rlang package adds its own classes after these, such as rlang_error, error and condition.

For example, create_env(overwrite = "yes") aborts with these classes:

c(
  "condathis_create_env_invalid_overwrite",
  "condathis_create_invalid_overwrite_arg",
  "condathis_invalid_overwrite",
  "condathis_invalid_arg",
  "condathis_error"
)

The checks of verbose, method and error are the same in every function, so their errors have only shared classes, for example:

c(
  "condathis_invalid_verbose",
  "condathis_invalid_arg",
  "condathis_error"
)

Handle the most general class that fits. A handler for condathis_env_not_found catches a missing environment in every function, and a handler for condathis_error catches every error of condathis.

Shared classes

  • condathis_invalid_arg
    An argument has an invalid value. condathis checks the arguments before it changes anything, so such an error has no side effects.

  • condathis_invalid_<argument>
    An invalid value of one argument, with its exact name. It always comes with the class condathis_invalid_arg. For example:

    • condathis_invalid_env_name

    • condathis_invalid_packages

    • condathis_invalid_channels

    • condathis_invalid_method

    • condathis_invalid_verbose

    • condathis_invalid_error

    • condathis_invalid_timeout

  • condathis_parse_match_spec_invalid_name
    condathis_parse_match_spec_invalid_url
    A package spec that condathis cannot read, such as "::", or the URL of a package file whose name is not <name>-<version>-<build>. condathis reads the specs when it compares them with an existing environment, in create_env(), install_packages() and validate_env(). Also condathis_invalid_arg.

  • condathis_env_not_found
    The environment does not exist. A missing environment is created only by run(), run_bin(), run_pipeline() and install_packages(), and only the default "condathis-env". With error = "continue", the run family returns status 127 instead. When the environment is in the data directory of a backend whose package cannot be used, the message names that backend (see the class condathis_backend_not_installed below).

  • condathis_backend_error
    A backend failed. The function classes are:

    • condathis_<function>_failed

    • condathis_<function>_resolve_failed
      a command or its activation could not be resolved.

    • condathis_backend_probe_failed

    The backend's error is the parent, so its classes are found by rlang::cnd_inherits(). The condathis_* classes of the backend's error are also copied, for example:

    • condathis_micromamba_status_error

  • condathis_backend_probe_failed
    A backend could not tell whether the environment exists. create_env(), install_packages() and remove_env() then stop before they change anything. Also condathis_backend_error.

  • condathis_backend_query_failed (a warning)
    With method = "auto", a query of one backend failed, and the function skipped that backend.

  • condathis_backend_invalid_return
    A backend returned a value that breaks the contract of register_backend(). The message names the backend. Also:

    • condathis_backend_contract_violation

    For the value of backend_resolve_run(), the first class is:

    • condathis_backend_resolve_run_invalid

  • condathis_backend_contract_violation
    A backend breaks the contract, when it is registered or in a return value.

  • condathis_backend_not_installed
    The package of a backend that condathis knows, such as "rattler" of the rattlerthis package, is not installed. It is:

    • an error when method names that backend (with the classes of an invalid method).

    • an error when a call would change an environment in the data directory of that backend (with condathis_backend_mismatch).

    • a warning when a query skips the environments of that backend (once per session).

    • a warning when clean_cache() cannot clean its caches.

  • condathis_backend_load_failed
    The same, when the package is installed but failed to load, did not register its backend, or its backend was unregistered in this session. The error of the load is the parent. Also a warning, once per session, when condathis tried to load the package. It tries this when its backend has environments or caches, or when the option condathis.backend_priority names it.

  • condathis_link_scripts_skipped (a warning)
    The backend did not run the pre-link, post-link or pre-unlink scripts of some packages, which micromamba runs, so these packages may not work. The call itself succeeded. The warning has the fields backend, env_name, packages (the package names, sorted) and scripts (a data frame with the columns package and script).

  • condathis_backend_quiesce_failed (a warning)
    with_sandbox_dir() or clean_cache() could not tell whether a backend still works in the R process, and went on.

  • condathis_env_lock_waiting (a message, neither an error nor a warning)
    create_env(), install_packages() or remove_env() waits for another R session that changes the same environment (see Other R sessions in create_env()).

  • condathis_cache_lock_waiting (a message)
    clean_cache() waits for other R sessions that create environments or install packages, or these wait for a clean_cache() of another session.

  • condathis_micromamba_downloading (a message)
    A function that needs micromamba found no usable binary and downloads the default version with install_micromamba(). The message names the version and the path. verbose = "silent" hides it.

  • condathis_env_lock_unavailable (a warning, once per session)
    The lock of the environment or of the package caches could not be taken, for example on a file system that cannot lock files. The call went on without it.

  • condathis_status_error
    A command of run(), run_bin() or run_pipeline() exited with a status other than 0.

  • condathis_timeout_error
    A command of run(), run_bin() or run_pipeline() ran longer than timeout and was killed.

  • condathis_micromamba_status_error
    A micromamba command that condathis started for the micromamba backend failed. It carries the fields status and stderr, also when it is the class of a backend failure that condathis re-raised.

  • Deprecated arguments and values, which still work but will be removed (warnings):

    • condathis_deprecated_packages_arg
      for packages = in create_env(), install_packages() and validate_env(): once per session and function, for calls from the console, a script or the tests of the calling package. Calls made inside other packages do not warn. options(lifecycle_verbosity = "warning") makes those calls warn too, and "quiet" turns the warning off.

    • condathis_deprecated_env_file_arg
      for env_file = in create_env(): pass an env_definition() in ... instead. The same rule as for packages =.

    • condathis_deprecated_method_native
      for method = "native" (once per session). create_env(), install_packages(), validate_env(), remove_env(), run() and run_bin() apply the same rule as for packages =.

    • condathis_deprecated_arg
      for timeout_limit in install_micromamba().

Error fields

The status and timeout errors of run(), run_bin() and run_pipeline() carry these fields, so a handler does not need to read the message:

  • status: the exit status, an integer. It is -9 for a timeout, and 127 for a command that could not start. A command killed by signal n has the status 128 + n in run() on Linux and macOS, as in a shell. In run_bin() and run_pipeline(), the status is -n.

  • stdout, stderr: the captured output, or NA when that stream was not captured.

  • timeout: TRUE for a timeout, FALSE otherwise.

The errors of run_pipeline() also carry result, the condathis_pipeline result, and statuses, the status of each command.

Classes of each function

Each function also raises the shared classes above. The checks of verbose, method and error raise only shared classes.

create_env()

The classes of create_env(). Arguments:

  • condathis_create_env_invalid_packages

  • condathis_create_env_positional_env_name

  • condathis_create_env_invalid_env_name

  • condathis_create_env_invalid_channels

  • condathis_create_env_invalid_channel_priority

  • condathis_create_env_invalid_platform

  • condathis_create_env_invalid_env_file
    an invalid value of the deprecated env_file.

  • condathis_create_env_missing_env_file
    the file of an env_definition() or of env_file does not exist.

  • condathis_create_env_invalid_overwrite

  • condathis_create_env_conflicting_args
    package specs and an env_definition(), two definitions, a definition and env_file, or channels, additional_channels or channel_priority with a lock file given by env_definition(). The deprecated env_file ignores them, as in 0.1.4.

  • condathis_create_env_unsupported_definition
    the backend cannot read the env_definition(), or no available backend can with method = "auto". Also condathis_backend_unsupported.

The environment:

  • condathis_create_env_exists
    it exists, and overwrite = FALSE cannot keep it. A lock file keeps it only when the environment has exactly the packages of the lock.

  • condathis_create_env_platform_mismatch

  • condathis_create_env_platform_not_locked
    a lock file lists none of the platforms that create_env() can use. Also condathis_create_env_platform_mismatch.

The backend:

  • condathis_create_env_failed
    also when a lock file that lists packages gives an empty environment.

  • condathis_create_env_link_scripts_skipped (a warning)

install_packages()

The classes of install_packages(). Arguments:

  • condathis_install_packages_missing_packages

  • condathis_install_packages_invalid_packages

  • condathis_install_packages_positional_env_name

  • condathis_install_packages_invalid_env_name

  • condathis_install_packages_invalid_channels

  • condathis_install_packages_invalid_channel_priority

  • condathis_install_packages_conflicting_args
    package specs and an env_definition(), or two definitions.

  • condathis_install_packages_missing_env_file
    the file of an env_definition() does not exist.

  • condathis_install_packages_unsupported_definition
    a lock file, or a file that the backend cannot read or install from (then also condathis_backend_unsupported).

The environment:

  • condathis_install_packages_env_not_found

The backend:

  • condathis_install_packages_failed

  • condathis_install_packages_link_scripts_skipped (a warning)

  • condathis_install_packages_missing_previous_channels (a warning)
    a channel the environment was built from is not in the call. This holds on every backend that records the channels in conda-meta/history.

remove_env()

The classes of remove_env():

  • condathis_remove_env_invalid_env_name

  • condathis_remove_env_env_not_found

  • condathis_remove_env_failed

  • condathis_remove_env_link_scripts_skipped (a warning)
    pre-unlink scripts.

clean_cache()

The classes of clean_cache():

  • condathis_clean_cache_failed
    a backend failed to clean its caches, or condathis could not empty one of its own cache directories. condathis raises it after it cleaned the other backends and directories.

    • A backend failure also has condathis_backend_error, with the error of the backend as the parent. For a non-zero status that the backend returned without an error, it has the fields status, stdout and stderr instead.

    • A directory failure has the error of the deletion as the parent.

  • condathis_backend_invalid_return
    a backend returned a status that is not a whole number.

  • condathis_backend_not_installed and condathis_backend_load_failed (warnings)
    name a backend whose caches were not cleaned.

validate_env()

The classes of validate_env(). Arguments:

  • condathis_validate_env_invalid_packages

  • condathis_validate_env_positional_env_name

  • condathis_validate_env_invalid_env_name

  • condathis_validate_env_invalid_channels

  • condathis_validate_env_invalid_platform

  • condathis_validate_env_conflicting_args
    package specs and an env_definition(), or two definitions.

  • condathis_validate_env_missing_env_file
    the file of an env_definition() does not exist.

  • condathis_validate_env_unsupported_definition
    a file that cannot be compared: a request such as environment.yml, a lock whose packages the backend does not report, or a lock without packages for platform. Also condathis_backend_unsupported when the backend cannot read the file.

The environment:

  • condathis_validate_env_env_not_found

  • condathis_validate_env_unsatisfied
    a spec is not satisfied, or the environment does not have exactly the packages of a lock file.

The backend:

  • condathis_validate_env_failed

Queries

These are the classes of the queries, with the name of the function as <function>. The queries are env_exists(), list_envs(), list_packages(), get_env_dir() and get_install_dir().

  • condathis_<function>_invalid_env_name
    for the functions that take env_name.

  • condathis_list_packages_env_not_found

  • condathis_<function>_failed
    not for get_env_dir().

install_micromamba()

The classes of install_micromamba(). Arguments:

  • condathis_install_micromamba_invalid_micromamba_version

  • condathis_install_micromamba_invalid_timeout

  • condathis_install_micromamba_invalid_download_method

  • condathis_install_micromamba_invalid_force

  • condathis_install_micromamba_conflicting_args
    timeout and timeout_limit.

Then:

  • condathis_install_micromamba_unsupported_version

  • condathis_install_micromamba_download_failed

The warnings about the SHA256 check of a download:

  • condathis_install_micromamba_checksum_unavailable
    the binary is installed without the check. verbose = "silent" hides it.

  • condathis_install_micromamba_checksum_mismatch
    the binary is not installed. Shown also with verbose = "silent".

The micromamba backend

  • condathis_micromamba_downloading (a message)
    no usable binary was found, so it is downloaded.

  • condathis_micromamba_status_error
    a micromamba command failed.

  • condathis_micromamba_bin_path_not_executable

  • condathis_micromamba_version_not_detected

  • condathis_micromamba_not_available_for_arch

Replacing an environment

For create_env() with overwrite = TRUE, on every backend, three classes apply:

  • condathis_env_set_aside_failed
    the existing environment could not be moved aside, so it is unchanged.

  • condathis_env_not_restored
    the create failed and the old environment could not be moved back. The error has the field kept_env_dir with where it is kept.

  • condathis_env_restore_failed (a warning)
    the same after an interrupt, also with kept_env_dir.

The micromamba backend adds:

  • condathis_micromamba_env_set_aside_failed

  • condathis_micromamba_env_restore_failed

When condathis replaces, removes or cleans up an environment, it refuses to delete or move a directory that is not exactly <root>/envs/<env_name>. The error has one of these classes:

  • condathis_unsafe_env_dir_delete

  • condathis_unsafe_env_dir_move

run() and run_bin()

The classes of run() and run_bin(), with run or run_bin as <function>. Arguments:

  • condathis_<function>_invalid_cmd

  • condathis_<function>_invalid_args
    a value in ..., also condathis_invalid_cmd_args.

  • condathis_<function>_invalid_input

  • condathis_<function>_invalid_binary

  • condathis_<function>_invalid_env_name

  • condathis_<function>_invalid_<argument>
    for timeout, supervise, cleanup_tree, linux_pdeathsig, stdin, stdout, stderr and, for run_bin(), activate.

Then:

  • condathis_<function>_env_not_found

  • condathis_<function>_resolve_failed

  • condathis_<function>_status_error

  • condathis_<function>_timeout_error

A failed activation of the micromamba backend adds the classes of its error to the resolve error:

  • On Linux and macOS, an activate.d script that exits with a non-zero status adds two classes:

    • condathis_micromamba_status_error

    • condathis_cmd_status_error

  • A missing or unreadable activation result adds condathis_activation_dump_error.

  • A missing environment directory adds condathis_activation_env_not_found.

run_pipeline()

The classes of run_pipeline(). Arguments:

  • condathis_run_pipeline_invalid_step

  • condathis_run_pipeline_too_few_commands

  • condathis_run_pipeline_conflicting_method

  • condathis_run_pipeline_invalid_env_name

  • condathis_run_pipeline_invalid_input

  • condathis_run_pipeline_invalid_binary

  • condathis_run_pipeline_invalid_<argument>
    for timeout, supervise, cleanup_tree, linux_pdeathsig, activate, stdin, stdout and stderr.

Then:

  • condathis_run_pipeline_env_not_found

  • condathis_run_pipeline_resolve_failed

  • condathis_run_pipeline_status_error

  • condathis_run_pipeline_timeout_error

run_step()

The classes of run_step():

  • condathis_run_step_invalid_cmd

  • condathis_run_step_invalid_args

  • condathis_run_step_invalid_env_name

  • condathis_run_step_invalid_method

  • condathis_run_step_invalid_stderr

env_path()

The classes of env_path():

  • condathis_env_path_invalid_path
    the path argument.

  • condathis_env_path_invalid
    a malformed env_path() object. It is also the second class of a path error.

  • condathis_env_path_read_only
    passed to a function that takes only names.

  • condathis_env_path_unsupported_method
    a method that names a backend that cannot run commands in such an environment, also condathis_backend_unsupported.

  • condathis_env_path_not_found
    condathis_env_path_not_conda_env
    also condathis_env_not_found.

env_definition()

The classes of env_definition():

  • condathis_env_definition_invalid_path
    the path argument, also a URL. Also condathis_invalid_path.

  • condathis_env_definition_invalid_format

  • condathis_env_definition_invalid_options
    an unnamed or repeated option in ....

  • condathis_env_definition_invalid
    a malformed env_definition() object, found by the function that gets it.

A definition passed to a function that takes only package specs or names aborts with the class of the invalid argument of that function.

parse_output()

The classes of parse_output():

  • condathis_parse_output_invalid_res

  • condathis_parse_output_invalid_stream

  • condathis_parse_output_invalid_trim

  • condathis_parse_output_binary_stream
    a raw stream cannot be parsed as text.

with_sandbox_dir()

The classes of with_sandbox_dir():

  • condathis_with_sandbox_dir_cleanup_failed (a warning)
    the sandbox could not be deleted.

Backend selection (method)

The classes of the choice of a backend with method:

  • condathis_backend_not_registered

  • condathis_backend_none_available

  • condathis_backend_mismatch
    a change to an environment of another backend.

  • condathis_backend_ambiguous_env
    several backends have the environment.

  • condathis_backend_not_installed
    condathis_backend_load_failed
    the package of the backend cannot be used.

The warnings:

  • condathis_backend_mismatch_warning

  • condathis_backend_marker_mismatch

  • condathis_invalid_backend_priority_option

register_backend() and unregister_backend()

The classes of register_backend() and unregister_backend():

  • condathis_backend_invalid_name

  • condathis_backend_reserved_name

  • condathis_backend_root_conflict
    the condathis data directory has an entry of that name that is not a directory.

  • condathis_backend_name_conflict
    the name differs only in case from another backend name.

  • condathis_backend_class_conflict

  • condathis_backend_contract_violation

A backend gives its own condition the class condathis_backend_unsupported when it cannot honor an argument, and never the class condathis_backend_error.

Renamed classes

These classes of condathis 0.1.4 were renamed to follow the scheme. Each old name is kept as an extra class until condathis 1.0, so existing handlers keep working. Use the new names in new code. Each item gives the new class, then the old one:

  • condathis_create_env_invalid_overwrite
    old: condathis_create_invalid_overwrite_arg

  • condathis_create_env_missing_env_file
    old: condathis_create_missing_env_file

  • condathis_remove_env_env_not_found
    old: condathis_error_env_remove

  • condathis_list_packages_env_not_found
    old: condathis_list_packages_missing_env

  • condathis_install_micromamba_download_failed
    old: condathis_install_error_missing_bzip2

  • condathis_micromamba_bin_path_not_executable
    old: condathis_umamba_bin_path_not_executable

  • condathis_micromamba_version_not_detected
    old: condathis_umamba_version_not_detected

  • condathis_micromamba_not_available_for_arch
    old: condathis_umamba_not_available_for_arch

  • condathis_micromamba_status_error
    old: condathis_cmd_status_error

  • condathis_run_invalid_cmd
    old: condathis_run_null_cmd

  • condathis_run_invalid_stdin
    condathis_run_bin_invalid_stdin
    old: condathis_run_stdin_error

  • condathis_run_bin_status_error
    old: condathis_run_status_error

  • condathis_run_invalid_args
    condathis_run_bin_invalid_args
    (a named value) old: rlib_error_dots_named, rlib_error_dots

condathis_install_error_missing_bzip2 is deprecated: a failed download does not depend on bzip2.

See also

condathis-options, register_backend()

Examples

condathis::with_sandbox_dir({
  # A missing environment, in any function
  print(tryCatch(
    condathis::list_packages(env_name = "no-such-env"),
    condathis_env_not_found = function(cnd) "not found"
  ))

  # An invalid argument aborts before anything runs
  print(tryCatch(
    condathis::create_env(env_name = "my-env", overwrite = "yes"),
    condathis_invalid_arg = function(cnd) class(cnd)
  ))
})
#> [1] "not found"
#> [1] "condathis_create_env_invalid_overwrite"
#> [2] "condathis_create_invalid_overwrite_arg"
#> [3] "condathis_invalid_overwrite"           
#> [4] "condathis_invalid_arg"                 
#> [5] "condathis_error"                       
#> [6] "rlang_error"                           
#> [7] "error"                                 
#> [8] "condition"                             

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
condathis::with_sandbox_dir({
  # The fields of a status error. The command is the Rscript of this R,
  # run in the default environment, which is created empty.
  rscript <- file.path(
    R.home("bin"),
    if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") "Rscript.exe" else "Rscript"
  )
  tryCatch(
    condathis::run(rscript, "-e", "quit(status = 3)", verbose = "silent"),
    condathis_status_error = function(cnd) cnd$status
  )
})
} # }
